# Discover Empty — a neighborhood without a knowledge base reports none, in
# text and JSON. The scenario creates no knowledge base; the home-anchored
# walk is bounded by the scenario work dir, so the empty subdirectory sees
# nothing even though sibling scenarios may live nearby.

mkdir $WORK/empty
cd $WORK/empty
exec akb discover
stdout 'no knowledge bases found near .*empty'
exec akb discover --json
stdout '^\[\]$'
